protocol.publishedRule: per rep: largest step whose stable-prefix is contiguous; per variant: min over reps
protocol.offlineRule: fresh OfflineAudioContext per N (via page avEngineBoot, engine default patch); notes midi = i (i in 0..N−1; facade rejects midi>127 → max measurable N = 128); sync barrier: await h.stats() after posting, before startRendering — every noteOn() === true && stats.active === N required (one fresh-context retry per cell, then STOP); usPerQuantum = (w2−w1)*1000 / ((T2−T1)*sr/128); published = max N ≤ 1333 µs
protocol.realtimeLattice: worklet clock = Date.now ms lattice — ring readings 0/1000/2000 µs; 0 means sub-1 ms, not zero cost

offline.method: fresh OfflineAudioContext per N · T1 = 1 s / T2 = 4 s · usPerQuantum = (w2 − w1)*1000 / ((T2 − T1)*sr/128)
offline.patch: engine defaults (= LIGHT bench patch: saw 1.0 · wt.saw 0.5 · lp24 800/0.3/envAmt 2 · env1 .002/.3/.8/.2 · env2 .001/.5/.5/.3 · uni 1 · lfo 0)
offline.deliveryRule: sync barrier: await h.stats() after the note posts, before startRendering; every noteOn() === true AND stats.active === N required; one fresh-context retry per cell, then STOP
offline.midiRule: notes post as midi = i (i in 0..N−1); the facade rejects midi>127 — the midi space caps measurable N at 128

fallback.whyNoRamp: file:// is a single-cell smoke of the degraded tier; the published number comes from the http ramp only (§9.1)
